Henry II of Champagne.fact: Philip left on 2 August, leaving Duke Hugh III of Burgundy as his lieutenant. Richard would stay longer, however, and on 25 August, he and Henry marched with their respective forces from Acre southwards along the coast.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: The crusaders' victory in the battle of Arsuf on 7 September dealt a significant blow to Ayyubid morale.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences
Henry II of Champagne.question: Richard and Henry then proceeded south to Jaffa, which Richard granted to _____'s brother Geoffrey of Lusignan
Henry II of Champagne.fact: Richard and Henry then proceeded south to Jaffa, which Richard granted to King Guy's brother Geoffrey of Lusignan.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: In January 1192, their troops began fortifying the city.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: On 16 April, he summoned the barons and knights of the Kingdom of Jerusalem to settle the dispute between Guy and Conrad, and they unanimously chose Conrad to be their new king.

Henry II of Champagne.fact: On 16 April, he summoned the barons and knights of the Kingdom of Jerusalem to settle the dispute between Guy and Conrad, and they unanimously chose Conrad to be their new king. Richard accepted their decision and sent Henry to Tyre to inform Conrad of his election.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences
Henry II of Champagne.question: Henry arrived around 20 April amid widespread celebration, and then promptly returned to prepare Acre for _____'s coronation
Henry II of Champagne.fact: On 16 April, he summoned the barons and knights of the Kingdom of Jerusalem to settle the dispute between Guy and Conrad, and they unanimously chose Conrad to be their new king. Richard accepted their decision and sent Henry to Tyre to inform Conrad of his election.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: Henry arrived around 20 April amid widespread celebration, and then promptly returned to prepare Acre for Conrad's coronation. On 28 April, however, two Assassins stabbed Conrad.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences
Henry II of Champagne.question: Henry, who preferred to return to his lands in France, met with _____ in Acre to consult
Henry II of Champagne.fact: As he lay dying, he commanded his pregnant wife, Isabella, not to deliver Tyre to anyone but Richard or a new king of Jerusalem; she thus shut herself in the city and refused Hugh of Burgundy's demands to hand it over. Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences
Henry II of Champagne.question: Henry married _____ within a week of her being widowed and took up residence in Acre
Henry II of Champagne.fact: Henry could not become the legitimate ruler of the kingdom without marrying Isabella, but he prevaricated because she was pregnant with Conrad's child, who–if a boy–might inherit the kingdom. Henry married Isabella within a week of her being widowed and took up residence in Acre.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences
Henry II of Champagne.question: He proceeded to capture Darum, which he gave to Henry, who arrived with Hugh on 23 May _____
Henry II of Champagne.fact: He proceeded to capture Darum, which he gave to Henry, who arrived with Hugh on 23 May 1192.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences
Henry II of Champagne.question: Darum was the last _____ fortress on the coast of Palestine, and its capture gave hope to the crusaders that Jerusalem too might be conquered

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: After the wedding, Richard asked Henry to join the host at Ascalon with all the troops from Tyre and Acre. In June, Henry went to Acre to gather the crusaders who were still dallying in fleshpots.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Saladin attacked Jaffa on 27 July while the crusaders were in Acre; when Richard learned of it two days later, he sent Henry south with an army while he went by sea, and they repelled the Ayyubids.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: Richard left on 11 October, making Henry the leader of the Catholic forces in Palestine.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: He was supported by the military orders and the leading baron, Balian of Ibelin, who was his wife's stepfather.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: As his obligations in Palestine grew, Henry gradually became less involved with the government of Champagne.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: He relied heavily on the wealth of his French lands to support the crusader kingdom.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: He doubted the loyalty of Guy's brother, Aimery of Lusignan, who had retained the office of constable and received the County of Jaffa from the third brother, Geoffrey. When Aimery intervened on behalf of the Pisans, Henry arrested him.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: He then proceeded to Antioch and into Cilicia, meeting Leo near Sis.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: They agreed that Leo would release Bohemond without ransom and retain Baghras, and that neither would owe fealty to the other.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.fact: Aimery's constable, Baldwin of Bethsan, came to Acre and persuaded Henry to meet with Aimery in 1197. When the German Crusade arrived in Acre in August 1197, Henry was reluctant to start another war.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences
Henry II of Champagne.question: Aimery sent one of his barons, _____, to defend Jaffa, but Reynald did not take the task seriously and Henry mustered his own men in Acre
Henry II of Champagne.fact: Aimery sent one of his barons, Reynald Barlais, to defend Jaffa, but Reynald did not take the task seriously and Henry mustered his own men in Acre.

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences

Henry II of Champagne.subject: Applied Sciences
